result.title: Coherence by Construction: Synthesizing CTI Knowledge Graphs and the Formal Limits of Coherence Validation
result.comment: 21 pages, 5 figures. Includes supplementary material (Sections S-I through S-X)
result.summary: Synthesizing relational training data such as knowledge graphs with a large language model typically emits structured objects one at a time, which keeps each object valid but leaves the relationships between them ungrounded. We study an alternative paradigm, generation by simulation: rather than describing a relational artifact, we simulate a process that produces it and take the artifact to be its causal record. Language-model agents propose intent and a deterministic referee resolves outcomes against an explicit world model, so a relation is emitted only when the event it represents occurs, making coherence a property of construction. We instantiate the paradigm for cyber threat intelligence knowledge graphs in the STIX 2.1 standard with three engines, among them an evolutionary engine applying language-model genetic operators to structured graph genomes, sharing a deterministic compiler that makes malformed and dangling output unrepresentable. We prove referential closure, causal grounding, and identifier stability, an ablation localizes each to the referee and world model rather than the policy, and two independent LLM judges reproduce the rubric's engine ranking. Our central result is cautionary, and we prove it: a validator reading any graph feature set a structure-matched random graph can reproduce is uninformative about coherence for a coherence-by-construction generator. Using Erdős-Rényi controls we realize the theorem four times, as structural separation, embedding transfer, inductive link prediction, and real-data augmentation each reward a triviality rather than coherence; we give the mechanism behind each and the conditions a valid benchmark must meet.

AI.brief_summary: 提出「以构造保证连贯」的关系型数据生成范式：LLM 代理提出意图，确定性裁判依据显式世界模型裁定事件，仅在事件发生时产出关系，并证明对这类生成器而言，只读图特征的校验器会被结构匹配的随机图复现而失去信息量。
AI.relevance_reason: 其以结构匹配随机图作零假设、按组件消融归因并论证校验器可能只奖励平凡性的思路，或可供核查 latent 状态是否真携带任务相关内容而非表面统计，但属远领域类比，需较多核查。
